card.name: Last digits of years in history
card.fires_on: A single digit that completes a four-digit year, such as 1746 or 1908, in historical prose. The digit is the third or fourth one in the year.

modes.label: Third digit of year
modes.description: The digit after 19 or 18 that gives the decade, in a historical date.

modes.label: Final digit of year
modes.description: The last digit of a year after the decade digit.
modes.example: In the years 1743 to 1<<7>>46 he worked as controller in Dresden

card.plain: It lights up on the digits inside a year number in history writing, like the 6 in 1966.
